title: Microsoft Teams Security & Compliance — Information Barriers, Retention & DLP
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Teams administration).

MicrosoftTeams PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Apply the Teams-specific security and compliance controls
problem: Teams carries chats, channel messages, and files that need compliance controls — and the Teams-specific ones are easy to miss. This solution applies Teams security & compliance: information barriers (segment groups that can't communicate), Teams retention policies (chat/channel), Teams DLP, and communication-compliance touchpoints — scoped to what's specific to Teams, referencing the broader Purview program rather than duplicating it.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Teams-specific controls: information barriers, Teams retention (chat/channel), Teams DLP, and how they relate to the org-wide Purview program.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing, roles, existing Purview retention/DLP posture, compliance stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — define + apply information-barrier policies (segments/associations), set Teams chat/channel retention, configure Teams DLP, and validate — pilot-first, each policy named; records/legal determinations deferred to compliance.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (barriers enforced, retention applied, DLP effective in Teams) plus Best Practices; broader DLP/labels handled by the Purview program.
short: Apply the Teams-specific security & compliance controls — information barriers, Teams chat/channel retention, and Teams DLP — scoped to Teams and aligned to your Purview program. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
